Animesh Kujur sets Indian 100m record on foreign soil

Animesh Kujur has set a new Indian record for the fastest 100-meter sprint achieved by an Indian athlete on foreign soil. He achieved this feat while competing in Germany, finishing second in the race with a time of 10.14 seconds. This performance marks a significant achievement for Indian athletics on the international stage.
